title: New LRT
statement: Starting at position 0, a traveller must reach position n. Each move adds a positive x that is a submask of m (m & x = x) and costs c_x. The task is to sum the costs of all ordered trips modulo 10^9+7, with n and m below 2^20 and their sums over tests at most 2^20. This rules out the direct O(n·2^popcount(m)) transition.
